title: Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Kit Bundle
description: This exclusive Vapestore bundle includes the compact and rechargeable Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit plus three full packs of Lost Mary BM600 Pods—giving you one reusable device and seven flavour-filled pods with the potential for up to 4200 puffs in one cost-effective setup. Designed to replicate the convenience of the bestselling Lost Mary BM600 disposable, this updated prefilled pod version delivers the same compact matchbox-style design and satisfying draw, with the added benefit of a rechargeable battery and replaceable pods. The kit comes preloaded with one 2ml pod of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid for a smooth and flavourful MTL vape, with inhale activation and no buttons or settings required. This bundle also includes three 2-packs of Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pods in your choice of flavours. With up to 600 puffs per pod, this refillable setup offers all the satisfaction of a disposable-style vape with far less waste—and greater value. With USB-C charging, a handy status light, and auto-draw functionality, the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit is ideal for both new and experienced vapers looking for simplicity, great flavour, and reusable convenience.
